title: P4.3M in smuggled cigarettes seized in Negros Occidental

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY— Police and other law enforcement agencies seized P4.35 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes and arrested two men during an operation in Barangay Balicotoc, Ilog, Negros Occidental, on Sunday. The Police Regional Office-Negros Island Region (PRO-NIR) identified the suspects on Monday only by their aliases, “Mak,” 44, and “Mar,” 24, both residents of Barangay Cogon in Dipolog City, Zamboanga del Norte. The suspects were intercepted while transporting 76 master cases of suspected smuggled cigarettes aboard a wing van truck, police said.
